title: The sealed door
starting_code:
# Walk up to the door.
# Cast zelim beside it to break the seal.
# Walk through to the end of the passage.
hints: Take two steps to the right to stand next to the door.
Use the `cast` action for the spell.
Walk three steps to the right after the seal breaks.
intro: That door is sealed with a glowing rune. You need a spell to break it, and a spell needs a wand! Stand beside it and cast zelim.
outro: You cast your first spell! The rune is gone and the door is open.
learned: Now you know about your first spell, a string cast with a wand.
